title: awesomePMC: pairwise and hidden Markov chains with copula-based non-Gaussian dependence

creators.name: Derrode, Stéphane
creators.affiliation: École Centrale de Lyon, CNRS, INSA Lyon, Université Lyon 1, Université Lumière Lyon 2, LIRIS, UMR5205, Écully, France

description:
Python library (import package pmcprg, distribution awesomepmc on PyPI) for pairwise and hidden Markov chains with copula-based non-Gaussian dependence: general pairwise Markov chains with pair-indexed margins; simulation, supervised MPM classification and unsupervised ICE/SEM estimation with automatic per-pair copula selection and GICE margin selection; standard errors and non-nested tests for the family choice; exact inference with missing observations, imputation and forecasting; detection of erroneous readings and robust estimation; image segmentation and a PyQt6 GUI.

API reference: https://sderrode.github.io/awesomePMC/. Package: https://pypi.org/project/awesomepmc/.

If you use awesomePMC in published work, please cite both papers it implements (Derrode & Pieczynski 2013 for the PMC model family and ICE-based copula selection; Derrode & Pieczynski 2016 for GICE, the automatic margin selection), and this software record.
references: Derrode, S., Pieczynski, W. (2013). Unsupervised data classification using pairwise Markov chains with automatic copulas selection. Computational Statistics & Data Analysis, 63, 81–98. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csda.2013.01.027

Derrode, S., Pieczynski, W. (2016). Unsupervised classification using hidden Markov chain with unknown noise copulas and margins. Signal Processing, 128, 8–17. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.sigpro.2016.03.008
